changeSet.sql:
set local lock_timeout = '5s';
alter table PROCESS_LOG_SEGMENTS add column if not exists PARENT_SEGMENT_ID bigint, add column if not exists SEGMENT_ATTEMPT smallint, add column if not exists SEGMENT_LOOP_INDEX int, add column if not exists SEGMENT_ROLE smallint, add column if not exists SEGMENT_THREAD int;

changeSet.author: ybrigo@gmail.com

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = current_schema() AND c.relname = 'process_events' AND c.relkind = 'r' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhparent = c.oid )

changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IDX_PROC_EVENTS_LOG_SEGMENT ON PROCESS_EVENTS ( INSTANCE_ID, INSTANCE_CREATED_AT, ((EVENT_DATA::jsonb ->> 'logSegmentId')::varchar), EVENT_SEQ ) WHERE EVENT_TYPE = 'ELEMENT'
